function: Multi-agent DRL jointly sets sensing and reporting times, honest-SU selection, SU and CBS beamforming, and passive and active RIS phase shifts to maximize sum data rate (p. 3-4).
system: MIMO cognitive radio: PU Np=4, SU Ns=3, CBS Nc antennas (Nc not given); R=4 passive and Q=4 active reflecting RIS, 64 elements each; no frequency band stated (p. 4).
method: Multi-agent actor-critic DRL (BARL) on a POMDP with belief states, PPO-style clipped policy loss; reinforcement training, 2,000 episodes of 200 time-steps (p. 4).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rician (k=5 for SUs, k=1 for PURs) on RIS links, Rayleigh elsewhere, distance path loss d^-alpha; imperfect CSI; no standard model or dataset (pp. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Training setting M=10 SUs, 2,000 episodes; Fig. 2b/2c sweep total SUs (4-20) and malicious-SU share (0-90%); paper does not state whether the model was retrained or reused (p. 4-5).
baselines: Learned: multi-agent PPO and DDPG (accumulated reward); no non-learned method; Fig. 2b compares the proposed system with and without RIS assistance (p. 5).
metrics: Accumulated reward per episode, sum data rate (bps/Hz), probability of detection, probability of false alarm, sum spectral efficiency under hyperparameter variation (p. 5).
complexity: Time complexity O(T*N*S^2)+O(N)+O(L*H^2) (T time-steps, N agents, S states, L layers, H neurons); no runtime or parameter count (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "remaining connections follow the Rayleigh fading pattern" (Rician on RIS links, path loss d^-alpha); own simulator, no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 5: "20 SUs, the data rate increases from 1.90"; the training setting is M = 10 (p. 4). Only sweeps of the SU count and malicious share are reported; no stated test of a trained model in new conditions.
q3_support: p. 5: "accumulated rewards over conventional PPO and a 34.46%" and "improvement over DDPG after 2000 episodes" (learned baselines); no non-learned method is compared, Fig. 2b only contrasts with and without RIS assistance (an ablation).
q4_support: p. 4: "POMDP model has time complexity" O(T*N*S^2)+O(N)+O(L*H^2), with T time-steps, N agents, L layers, H neurons; no runtime or FLOPs.
q5_support: p. 5: "TensorFlow 2.4 on an NVIDIA RTX 3080 GPU"; the paper gives no link or DOI for code or data and uses its own simulated channels, not a public dataset.
notes: The first page holds the title and DOI of the work. Included as area 3: the learned agents output SU and CBS beamformers and passive/active RIS phase shifts, and the objective is the sum data rate (p. 3-4). The agents also set sensing and reporting times and honest-SU selection against SSDF attacks (spectrum sensing, outside the seven areas), so the reviewer should confirm that the beamforming and RIS part is enough for the function check. The without-RIS curves of Fig. 2b are a system ablation, not a non-learned baseline. Table I varies batch size, soft update and clip range only.
